title: QAOA Demonstration
subtitle: QAOA
description: This notebook demonstrates Classiq's implementation of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), focusing on the Max Clique problem. It solves a Pyomo combinatorial optimization model with the built-in QAOA, `CombinatorialProblem`, and compares the circuit depth, CX count and convergence with Qiskit's QAOA.
